headline.title: The NSA’s classified network goes down
headline.quip: The agency built to intercept everyone’s communications couldn’t reach its own. Staff were told to arrive in shifts so they wouldn’t all hit the login page at once.
headline.summary: The NSA’s internal network, NSANet, suffered an outage that the agency called a “temporary degradation during scheduled routine maintenance.” Staff at Fort Meade were given staggered arrival times, and there was no evidence of a cyberattack. No restoration time was given.

also.title: Apple’s iCloud, App Store and Apple Pay stumble
also.summary: iCloud users were signed out, and the App Store, Apple Music, Apple Pay, AppleCare and App Store Connect had problems; store systems in New York and Chicago were offline for over an hour. Apple said an internal update caused the outages, not a cyberattack.

also.title: The National Weather Service website goes dark for 40 minutes
also.summary: NOAA said routine network maintenance took down National Weather Service websites and data services from 11:05 to 11:45 a.m. ET, drawing more than 400 Downdetector reports. NOAA Weather Radio and NOAAPort weren’t affected.
